basics.name: Nguyen Hong Phuc
basics.label: BSc ECE Student & AI / Wireless Sensing Researcher
basics.summary: Electrical and Computer Engineering student at VinUniversity specializing in wireless sensing, signal processing, and AI/ML for physical-world perception. Research at HKU AIoT Lab and ICCL Lab (VinUni & Trinity College Dublin). Recipient of a $3,500 Student Research Grant. Seeking fully funded Ph.D. positions for Fall 2027.

work.name: HKU AIoT Lab, The University of Hong Kong
work.summary: Selected as 1 of 40 students for a fully funded summer research internship; supervised by Prof. Chenshu Wu on privacy-preserving fall detection using low-resolution thermal (62×80 IRA) sensing.
highlights: Re-architected the real-time inference pipeline for NVIDIA Jetson Orin, raising throughput from 6.7 to 20.8 FPS and cutting display latency from 3 s to under 0.3 s, via a CNN feature cache (−80% encode calls), window/stride tuning, and AMP FP16.
Built a 45-session, 91,800-frame thermal + RGB + depth dataset with a zero-manual-annotation labelling pipeline (YOLOv8n-Pose on RGB, projected into thermal space and thermally gated).

Benchmarked 6 detector versions at IoU@0.5, cutting false positives on empty frames from 40.7% to 1.5%; traced dominant error to preprocessing rather than model capacity (10× FPR reduction from one line).

work.name: Intelligence, Computing and Communication Lab (ICCL), VinUniversity & Trinity College Dublin
work.summary: Supervised by Assist. Prof. Nguyen Van Dinh.
highlights: Investigated Open RAN architecture, 5G networks, and Task-Oriented Semantic Communication under supervision of Prof. Nguyen Van Dinh.
Developed multi-modality AI models for smart aquaculture: computer vision for fish tracking, underwater size estimation, and image segmentation.
Explored Diffusion Models for enhanced data generation and signal processing.
Recipient of a $3,500 Student Research Grant to lead smart aquaculture research.

work.name: FPT Software
work.summary: Top 20 Finalist at the IoT Challenge 2025.
highlights: Deployed quantized LLMs (LLaMA/Mistral with GGUF) on Raspberry Pi to build a conversational assistant.
Engineered a full-stack solution (Frontend/Backend) for real-time shopper tracking and route optimization via BLE localization.

work.name: WorldQuant
highlights: Developed predictive mathematical models (Alphas) to forecast financial instrument price movements.
Performed statistical analysis on historical data to optimize trading signals.
